title: Do Small Models Use the Law You Give Them? Measuring Context Use on a Bilingual Bangladesh Legal Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2608.30327v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fine-tuning can improve legal question-answering accuracy without improving how models use law supplied in context. We study this distinction in bilingual Bangladeshi legal QA, where observed errors can arise from answer scoring, retrieval, or failure to use relevant law. We construct a hierarchy-preserving statutory corpus, 2,165 reviewed bilingual fine-tuning examples, and a 150-item supplied-law control. We evaluate six instruction-tuned models: Llama-3.2-1B, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen3.5-0.8B, Qwen3.5-2B, Qwen3.5-4B, and Gemma-4-E2B, with three LoRA seeds per model. To separate effects, we combine constrained option-letter scoring, cyclic option rotation, and controlled removal of the governing provision. On 398 Bar Council outputs, an exact-line parser attributes an accuracy gain of 50.0\% to the Qwen3.5-2B seed-42 adapter, whereas option scoring yields only $3.0\%$. translated_title: 小模型会使用你给它们的法律吗？在双语孟加拉国法律基准上测量上下文使用情况
translated_abstract: 微调可以提高法律问答的准确性，却未必能改善模型对上下文中提供的法律条文的使用。我们在双语孟加拉国法律问答任务中研究这一区别，该场景下观察到的错误可能源于答案评分方式、检索失败或未能使用相关法律。我们构建了一个保留层级结构的成文法语料库、2,165个经审校的双语微调样本，以及一个包含150个条目的“所提供法律”对照集。我们评估了六个指令微调模型：Llama-3.2-1B、Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen3.5-0.8B、Qwen3.5-2B、Qwen3.5-4B和Gemma-4-E2B，每个模型使用三个LoRA随机种子。为了分离各种效应，我们结合了受限选项字母评分、循环选项轮换以及受控移除适用法律条款的方法。在398个Bar Council输出上，精确行解析器将50.0%的准确率提升归因于Qwen3.5-2B seed-42适配器，而选项评分仅得出3.0%。对于Gemma-4-E2B，两种评分方法青睐不同的系统。
tldr: 本研究构建了双语孟加拉国法律基准，发现微调虽能提升法律问答准确率，但不一定改善模型对上下文中法律条文的实际使用，且评分方法的选择会导致评估结果出现高达50.0%与3.0%的巨大差异。
en_tdlr: This study builds a bilingual Bangladesh legal benchmark showing that fine-tuning improves legal QA accuracy without necessarily improving models' use of law supplied in context, and that the choice of scoring method can cause evaluation outcomes to differ dramatically (50.0% vs. 3.0% accuracy gains).
